defects.statement: Stage 1 acceptance term BLOOM short-term -14 +/-1 LU unmet: S-max -18.12 / -16.95 / -16.88 / -18.94 (excerpts), -18.75 (bed-check). Mechanism (safety compressor -20 dB, 8:1, 30 dB knee) confirmed by builder and auditor; the Stage 2 treatment as written (compressor kept, subtract-only limiter) cannot deliver the window. Judge ruling: Stage 2 dependency requiring contract amendment draft-v3; not a Stage 1 patch, not a retarget (owner loudness decision).
defects.requestedRepair: Full triad signs draft-v3: move the BLOOM term to Stage 2 acceptance; authorise Stage 2 to retune or replace the safety compressor as part of the limiter change; restate the bare-era regression as 'identical except the mastering tail' with a newly pinned before hash; record in human-decision.json under delegated taste. Until signed, open-high against Stage 1.
defects.verificationRoute: contract gate on draft-v3 signatures; Stage 2 combined render S-max on a BLOOM excerpt; re-judge

defects.statement: Lean tier sounds tones.slice(1,4): three chord tones where full hears five. Contracted (performancePlan: 'Lean: three voices'), equal to the shipped voice count, and rendered in band by the verifier (-19.85 LUFS, corr 0.892). Residual is an owner-audition taste risk only.

defects.statement: Contract names audio main-thread cost <= 1.5 ms/frame full and <= 3 ms/frame lean at 4x CPU throttle on the SwiftShader gate; no such measurement exists. fps.txt is vsync-capped (60.39 vs 60.38 baseline) and proves no regression below vsync, not headroom, against a measured 1.7x offline DSP cost.
defects.requestedRepair: Measure audio-thread ms/frame for full and lean; run lean on the SwiftShader gate at 4x CPU throttle; file under evidence/stage-1/.
defects.verificationRoute: story-verifier re-runs the probe and records the numbers in verification-report.json

defects.statement: Verification disagreement: README/ab-results claim bare-era max delta 1 LSB / 6 samples; independent re-render measures 2 LSB / 3634 samples at -84.29 dBFS on bare-story-ch1-fixed, fingerprint still identical. The render is not bit-deterministic at the float floor across runs. Related: audio:check replay delta 8.91e-5 against the 1e-4 gate (builder 3.05e-5), 89% of gate with ~3x run variance.

Do not loosen the 1e-4 gate.

defects.statement: TAIL_REFERENCE_GAIN_DB +1.99 (mixTuning.ts:37, on the safety trim) contradicts acceptanceCriteria[5]/[6] and score.mixIntent "no makeup exists anywhere". Judge ruling: accept as the loudness architecture per HD-08(1) — level-preserving, named, tested, re-measured (-0.0074 dB); enforcing the letter drops the game 2 dB and voids four signed measurements. "Unity-in-effect" is a fiction: the contract must name it as +1.99 dB of static reference gain. Taste exception under delegation; open-high until draft-v4 is signed.
defects.requestedRepair: draft-v4: evidence.acceptanceCriteria[5] and [6] no-makeup sentence; score.mixIntent names TAIL_REFERENCE_GAIN_DB; score.cues[0..9].mixIntent same sentence x10; human-decision.json acceptedExceptions gains HD-08(1) bound to the draft-v4 sha.

defects.statement: C6 literal trigger fires (LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_PATH_S 25.215 ms > 16.7 ms) on a rationale Stage 2 made false: SFX also pass the post-join limiter, so the governing skew is LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_VS_SFX_S 14.875 ms (0.89 frame). Ruling: c6-amendment.md adopted — image members target device + music-path; SFX members of the five playSfx-bearing bundles (storyAwaken x3, shipCrash, storyGlitch — census confirmed against the contract) are forward-scheduled by the skew; no global SFX delay. README deviation 5 census "three" -> five.

defects.statement: Latency constants published in seconds measured only at 44.1 kHz. Auditor proposed sample-count derivation (1112/456 samples); Cinematography dissents (D-2): DynamicsCompressor pre-delay is 6 ms in time in Chromium/Gecko, so ~18 ms of 25.2 ms is rate-invariant and the samples-derived 23.17 ms is ~1.4 ms wrong at 48 kHz. Judge rules for Cinematography on the physics: measure per rate, pin each, select by ctx.sampleRate. Dissent preserved until the 48 kHz render.
defects.requestedRepair: mixTuning.ts per-rate table (44100, 48000) each measured by measureTailLatencyS in an OfflineAudioContext at that rate; audio:check pins each entry; selection by ctx.sampleRate at arming. Contract path: the amended C6 text carries it.
defects.verificationRoute: audio:check at both rates; verifier re-measures

defects.statement: Blind: 0.51 sample-step at 20.013 s in stress-mining-burst, identical before and after (inherited). Cause: forty same-seed mine chips at STRESS_MINING_BURST_AT_S 20 summed coherently in the offline rim (no queue, no rate limiter; README deviation 6). Live, the frame queue collapses them to one chip; the per-chip onset step (~0.013) is a Stage 4 recipe onset question. Not a Stage 2 defect.
defects.requestedRepair: Documentation now (README deviation 6 names the coherent sum); Stage 4: recipe onset check on the mine chip under the spectral-fingerprint regression.

defects.statement: Blind: brick-wall ~6.3 kHz lowpass switching in at 8.5 s and out at 53.5 s in stress-oxygen-dive, both versions (inherited). Not edge-triggering in the music path: setMusicSubmerged slews 0.42 s enter / 0.65 s exit via rampParam. The stress script steps submergence 0 -> 0.85 at 8 s and back at 54 s (excerpts.ts:1515) where live play is a continuous scalar; the SFX muffle is edge-snapped by design (SFX_SUBMERGE_EDGE 0.5, 80 ms enter slew, sfxEngine.ts:356). "6.3 kHz" is where the 12 dB/oct roll-off from ~930 Hz (music at 0.85) / 560 Hz (SFX) crosses the spectrogram floor. Lane: Integration (script authoring); Score confirms the dive gesture at audition.
defects.requestedRepair: Ramp submergence over >= 1 s in the dive stress script (or document the step); one spectrogram at 0.1 s resolution across the 8 s edge proving the 0.42 s music slew; owner listens to the 80 ms SFX snap.

defects.statement: Duck attack "passes with 0.34 ms margin" is a 5 ms-bin artefact: raw full depth lies in (45, 50] ms so the true margin is 0.3-5.3 ms after the legitimate 10.34 ms shared-latency subtraction (impact and duck both pass the limiter). The 40 ms term equals the row attack constant, so it is met and marginal by construction.
defects.requestedRepair: Integration: 1 ms duck-trace resolution. draft-v4: acceptanceCriteria[5] duck wording "within 1 dB of table depth inside the row attack time, measured from the audible impact onset".

defects.statement: acceptanceCriteria[5] "mining-metronome-probe.mjs returns an unchanged result" is literally false (max suppressed/3 s 5 -> 0) and correctly so (the queue absorbs retriggers). Worse, the probe's own PASS criterion (completion cycles at each stance) is unmet before and after: activeMine=0s, cycles=0 on every stance — the sandbox-no-op instrument (reset.sandboxNoOp) cannot engage mining and proves only the pickup admit path. Pre-existing.
defects.requestedRepair: draft-v4: acceptanceCriteria[5] names the fields (loop guard never engaged; admit <= 1.33/s; 0 errors; inventory grows each stance; suppressed/3 s may fall). Integration: make the probe engage mining (pointer-lock/stance) before Stage 4 changes SFX.
defects.verificationRoute: probe re-run showing cycles > 0 at each stance
